item.title: performOutbox reports done/failed even when the outcome write fails, leaving the record stuck in 'performing'

work.summary: performOutbox (packages/appboundry-host/src/transactions.ts) wrote the outcome with a version-guarded put, and if that put threw it only warned and still returned next.state ('done' or 'failed'). The record stayed 'performing', and recoverOutbox counted it as performed. Changed it so the outcome write is retried up to OUTCOME_WRITE_ATTEMPTS (3) times, and only while the stored record is still at the claim's version. 'done' or 'failed' is returned only after the write succeeds. If the outcome cannot be recorded, it warns 'could not record <state>' and returns 'skipped', so callers no longer count an unrecorded outcome as done or failed. The docstring is updated to match. Added packages/appboundry-host/test/outbox-outcome.test.ts with a one-record store whose writes can be made to fail. It covers three cases: an unrecordable done returns 'skipped' and leaves the record 'performing'; the same holds for an unrecordable failed; and a transient write failure is retried and recorded as done with its result. All three tests failed before the change and pass after it. The existing transactions.test.ts still passes (7 tests), as does the build (tsc -b).
